instruction:
Compare astral-sh/ruff, pylint-dev/pylint, and PyCQA/flake8 using their public GitHub pages. For each
    repository, report stars, forks, open issue count, latest stable release tag, latest stable release publication date,
    and license. Present the results in a table, rank the repositories by stars, and identify which has the newest stable
    release. Stopping condition: stop after all eighteen repository facts, the ranking, and the release comparison have
    been verified. Constraints: do not sign in; do not star, watch, fork, clone, download, or modify repositories; exclude
    prereleases; record counts exactly as GitHub displays them.
